name: saytype
description: Voice input method software built with Tauri

scripts.build: node scripts/bump-dev-build.js && CI=true tauri build && node scripts/collect-artifacts.js
scripts.build:mac: node scripts/bump-dev-build.js && CI=true sh -c '[ -f scripts/sign.env ] && . ./scripts/sign.env; tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin' && node scripts/collect-artifacts.js aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:mac:install: node scripts/bump-dev-build.js && CI=true sh -c '[ -f scripts/sign.env ] && . ./scripts/sign.env; tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin' && node scripts/collect-artifacts.js aarch64-apple-darwin --install

author: Tao
